measurement_notes: 2026-09-26 scoped workflow profile. Explicit prompt argument adapter, request-review, fixed model. Declared relative-path reads/setup, IDF and host build/test commands; native file tools write only to exact run checkout. Read grants only pinned IDF SDK and manufacturer source, not backups. IDF child-shell launcher pinned to 5.3.2. Per-run effective settings hash captured by wrapper; static policy hash is explicitly canonical JSON semantic SHA to avoid line-ending ambiguity. Diagnostic smoke is separate from product pilot and logged; provider cache isolation not claimed. Use --workspace equal to manifest checkout. New frozen baseline and receipt required; no in-run permission changes. Read-array revision: relative comma-separated Get-ChildItem paths and nonnegative -Depth supported; separate AGY diagnostic verified. Host toolchain revision 20260927: operator-provisioned LLVM-MinGW 20260616, archive SHA256 b9b68a4d276e16fa25802aaba458e4638f64b3884c290aaccdc2d87083b6ca35. activate-idf checks executable hashes and supplies process PATH; C/C++ runtime and IDF smoke required. New common prompt forbids replacement of production C tests by Python replicas. Prior pilot inputs are not comparable. Checkout-only git ls-files enumeration added; no history/ref traversal. Raw AGY DONE does not prove exit zero; failed_commands is a tool-error count, output-based failure audit required before quantitative comparison.
